name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
archDisplay: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformer (configuration undisclosed); natively multimodal (text/image/video/audio/PDF in, text out), 1,048,576-token input / 65,536-token output, thinking at low/medium/high
note: Google's September 2, 2026 Flash — its third in 43 days — at identical specifications and identical introductory pricing to 3.7 Flash ($0.75/$3.75 per Mtok until December 31, 2026, then $1.50/$7.50), and ahead of 3.7 Flash on every published row, so there is no reason to stay on the older model. Google's pitch is that it 'works harder': more reasoning steps and iterative tool calls on complex tasks. Available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, Antigravity, Gemini Enterprise and the Gemini app for AI Pro/Ultra subscribers. The honest reading of Google's own 14-row table is that it wins 8 and loses 5 to Claude Opus 5, and the losses are where the work is open-ended: Terminal-Bench 4.0 19.1 vs 51.8, OSWorld-2.0 59.0 vs 75.4, GDPval-AA v2 1545 vs 1824. It is excellent at bounded professional tasks — finance, law, charts, video, biology — at roughly a seventh of Opus 5's price, and its DeepSWE v1.1 73.7 is within noise of Opus 5's 74.0. Widely-circulated DeepSWE figures of 74% for this model come from the public Datacurve leaderboard rather than Google's table. Its FrontierCode 1.1 rows are deliberately omitted here: the only published values come from a competitor's comparison table and are identical to 3.7 Flash's, which cannot be distinguished from a carried-forward figure.

results.notes: DeepSWE v1.1, Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash launch table; up from 3.7 Flash's 65.3 and within 0.3 points of Claude Opus 5 (74.0) at roughly a seventh of the price. The public Datacurve leaderboard separately lists 74%.
GDPval-AA v2 Elo, Google's launch table; up from 1482 but far behind Claude Opus 5 (1824) — the widest of Google's five losses in its own table.
Vals Finance Agent v2, Google's launch table; best in row ahead of Claude Opus 5 (58.6) and GPT-5.6 Sol (53.8).
Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark, Google's launch table; best in row (Opus 5 6.7, GPT-5.6 Sol 2.5).
Terminal-Bench 2.1, Google's launch table; best in row ahead of Claude Opus 5 (89.1) and GPT-5.6 Sol (88.8).
Terminal-Bench 4.0, Google's launch table; up from 3.7 Flash's 11.2 but 32.7 points behind Claude Opus 5 (51.8) — general agent capability is where the Flash line is weakest.
GDP.PDF expert document comprehension, Google's launch table; behind Claude Opus 5 (37.0) and GPT-5.6 Sol (40.0).
CharXiv Reasoning, Google's launch table; best in row.
LVBench long-video understanding, Google's launch table; best in row by a wide margin over Claude Opus 5 (75.4).
HLE-Verified, stated in the launch post's prose as well as the table; best in row but the field is tightly bunched (Opus 5 54.4, GPT-5.6 Sol 54.5, 3.7 Flash 53.6).
OSWorld-2.0 computer use, Google's launch table; up from 3.7 Flash's 50.6 but 16.4 points behind Claude Opus 5 (75.4).
